title: Read the plan and the table

blocks.content: To read how the database runs the query, complete the following steps. If a tab is empty, skip it and go on.

blocks.title: Read the plan and the table

blocks.content:
Open the **Explain plan** tab. Explain plans exist for SELECT queries. If your query is not a SELECT, or the tab is empty, skip this tab.

Record the highlighted operation's name and its **Rows** estimate. The plan highlights an operation that takes 30% or more of the total query cost.

Record the access method: through an index, or by reading every row. A table scan on a small table, or on a query that returns most of the rows, can be acceptable. A table scan with no suitable index, or with an index that is not used, is the one to act on.

Open the **Table schema details** tab. If the tab is empty, skip it.

When the query uses several tables, each table has its own columns. Record whether the column the query filters on has an **Indexed** badge.

If an index exists, record whether its columns are in the same order as the query's filter and sort. Record whether the columns the query joins on are indexed too.
You have a record of the highlighted operation and of whether the filtered column is indexed.
